overcoat.line: I feel you in the pocket of my overcoat
stanza: I feel you in the pocket of my overcoat
My fingers wrap around your words
And take the shape of games we play

raincoat.line: I need a phone call, I need a raincoat
stanza: I need a phone call, I need a raincoat
I need a big love, I need a phone call

raincoat.line: In the whale, there is a man without his raincoat
stanza: In my town, there is a raincoat under a tree
In the sky, there is a cloud containing the sea
In the sea, there is a whale without any eyes
In the whale, there is a man without his raincoat
